sentences.text:
Petitioners are present before this Court and have been identified by their counsel Mr. P.K.
Sahrma and Investigating Officer (IO) SI Hawa Singh from Police Station Mangolpuri, Delhi.
6. The brief facts of the present case are that petitioner no. 1 had married to respondent no. 2 on 04.03.2017 at Delhi according to Hindu Rites and Ceremonies.
No child was born out of the said wedlock.
After the marriage, owing to temperamental differences, the relationship between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no.2 deteriorated.
On complaint of respondent no. 2, an FIR bearing no. 882/2018 was registered at Police Station Mangolpuri, Delhi for the offences punishable under Section 498A/406/34 of IPC against the petitioners.

It is stated that during the pendency of litigations, both the parties had amicably resolved their disputed on vide Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) dated 14.02.2023.
7.

On a query made by this Court, respondent no. 2 who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.

It is also stated by respondent no. 2 that the entire dispute has been amicably settled vide MoU dated 14.02.2023.
8.

It is submitted that no.2 has settled all her claims in respect of her dowry articles, stridhan,
marriage expenses, jewellery, gift items and claims of past, present and future maintenance and permanent alimony with petitioner no.1 and other family members.

9. The petitioner no. 1 had paid a sum of Rs. 3,00,000/- in three instalments in the following manner:
a. First installment of Rs. 1,00,000/- paid to respondent no. 2 at This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
Third/Final instalment of Rs. 1,00,000/- to be paid at the time of quashing of the FIR before the Honble High Court at New Delhi.

10. Today, the complainant who is present in Court states that she has received the last and final instalment of Rs. 1,00,000/- today, i.e., 31.05.2023 vide DD No. 396712 drawn on Bank of Maharashtra, Vikaspuri Branch, New Delhi and has no objection if the FIR is quashed.

11.
